note: Every measured delta this lane has read, with the comparison it is. R190's first registration named four banks and one delta each, and the deltas turned out to be three different quantities plus one row that belonged to a run which drove no games; a correlation over that table is a correlation over nothing. So each row here carries a `quantity`, which is what a rank correlation is allowed to vary one of, and a `comparison`, which is the sentence a reader needs. `score_bank.py --effects` refuses a row without either. Only deltas read in a single dispatch against a control drawn in that dispatch are admitted: a difference between two rounds is a difference of two draws, and this lane has measured draw-to-draw movement at five games on 274.
